email.subject: PO-120 partial delivery and backorder
email.text:
Hello,

On PO-120 revision 3, line 10 (KF-A-01) we can deliver 40 EA to your warehouse on 23 October 2026. The remaining 80 EA are on backorder and we do not have a delivery date yet.

We will update you as soon as we know more.
Kestrel Fasteners

expected.downstream: intake accept; undated remainder never counts as on time; no invented promise
